summary: Mobilicom filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 14, 2026 press release announcing a follow-on production order for its Mobile Ground Control Stations from an Asia-based Tier-1 robotics conglomerate serving military and industrial markets. No price, share count, stake, premium or closing date is disclosed; the customer previously ordered across the MCU Mesh Networking, SkyHopper Datalink and Mobile Ground Station families. Chairman Oren Elkayam signed; no advisor or board recommendation appears because this is a commercial order, not a transaction. No special-situation mechanics, overhang or regulatory clock; watch for order-size disclosure and revenue timing, with no risk-arb angle.
